result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, with oldest first within each priority. This is the same ordering the sales-rep list already uses.

The change is one SQL `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 10021). The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded. The only caller is `RegionManagerService`, and nothing else depends on the old order.

`RegionManagerTest`, `TicketsPerRegionTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass (8 tests, offline). I did not add a test that checks the new order against your example. Nothing is committed.
